name: International Refugee Assistance Project (IRAP)
story: Every **{litigation-policy: cost_total / people_affected_per_year|$}** of its litigation covers one refugee or visa holder with a court win, and every **{legal-services: cost_total / (people_reached * share_reaching_safety)|$}** of its legal services brings one refugee lasting safety.
summary: A US legal aid and advocacy organisation for refugees and displaced people, founded at Yale Law School in 2008, with offices in New York, Washington, Berlin, Amman and Beirut. Its lawyers, pro bono partners and law-student chapters help refugees reach safety through resettlement, family reunification, humanitarian visas and Special Immigrant Visas, and it litigates and campaigns to open and defend those pathways. In the year to August 2025 it served 4,884 clients.
